45: Sabba de-Sabbin (“Oldest of the Old”). Ḥokhmah, Keter.
Seder Zemanim (“Sequence of Time”). Tiferet and Malkhut.
Sanhedrin Gedolah (“The Great Sanhedrin”). Tiferet. Ketanah (“The Lesser [Sanhedrin]”). Malkhut.
Sefirat ha-Omer (“Counting of the Omer”). Malkhut.
Sefer (“Book”). Tiferet, Malkhut, and the Righteous [Yesod].
